title: Rock and Roll March and never filing with BMI
summary: Matassa's Rock and Roll March by the Rhythm Aces on Ace was an experiment; he admits he never filed clearance forms and was not thinking about money then.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
